product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™8K60 1x4 HDMI Splitter With Audio Extraction HDMI 2.1 HDCP 2.3Distribute and Display One HDMI Source to Any or All of Four Outputs Seamlessly and EffortlesslyEnhance your AV setup with the updated Blackbird 8K60 1x4 HDMI Splitter, the ultimate solution for distributing a single HDMI source across four outputs. Experience unparalleled video quality with native support for resolutions up to 8K60 4:2:0 12‑bit and beyond for devices supporting DSC (Display Stream Compression), ensuring every detail is captured with precision. The advanced EDID (Extended Display Identification Data) management guarantees seamless compatibility, preventing the ‘black screen of death’ during source transitions.The integrated downscaler feature intelligently adapts video content to match the maximum resolution supported by each connected device. Unlike standard splitters that limit output to the lowest common resolution, the Blackbird splitter allows a flawless mix of 4K and 1080P displays, ensuring each screen displays its full potential.Audio extraction is effortlessly handled by the Blackbird 8K60 1x4 HDMI Splitter, offering both analog and digital optical output options for your external audio system.
